name: Magic Axe Hut (Wilderness)
accessNote: 9 Magic axe spawns inside the Wilderness Axe Hut (west of the Bone Yard). The hut door requires 23 Thieving and a lockpick to open. Krystilia only counts Wilderness kills, so the Taverley Dungeon and Catacombs of Kourend spawns do not count. Multicombat, cannon and safespot are not wiki-stated for this spot; conservative defaults are used.
